<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

List, apply and decide the proposed fixes.

```text
The fixes that the gates and the AI judgment propose, awaiting a decision.

A suggestion is a git patch plus the why. The STATE is the folder it lives in
(pending/approved/rejected): moving it is deciding.

  anchors suggest list                          what awaits a decision
  anchors suggest show <id>                     the why and the diff
  anchors suggest apply <id> --reason "..."     applies the patch and approves
  anchors suggest reject <id> --reason "..."    rejects, with the reason

The reason is MANDATORY when deciding: without it, choice and carelessness become
indistinguishable — the same rule as the bare '@no-test'.
```

## Uso

```bash
anchors suggest
```

## Subcomandos

### `anchors suggest apply`

Apply the patch and move the suggestion to approved.

```text
Applies the patch with 'git apply' and, if it works, approves the suggestion.

The application comes BEFORE the approval on purpose: approving something that does not apply
would leave the record saying the fix went in when it did not.
```

#### Uso

```bash
anchors suggest apply <id> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--auto` |  | mark the decision as automatic (enable_auto_judgment) |
| `--dry-run` |  | only check whether the patch still applies |
| `--reason` |  | why accept it (goes into the record) |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |

### `anchors suggest list`

List the suggestions in a state (default: pending).

#### Uso

```bash
anchors suggest list [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--state` | `pending` | pending\|approved\|rejected |

### `anchors suggest reject`

Reject a suggestion, with the reason.

```text
Rejects the suggestion. The reason is MANDATORY — and the rejected one is NOT erased:
it is the record that keeps the same proposal from coming back in the next sweep as
news, and that preserves the reason for whoever comes later.
```

#### Uso

```bash
anchors suggest reject <id> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--auto` |  | mark the decision as automatic (enable_auto_judgment) |
| `--reason` |  | why refuse it (REQUIRED) |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |

### `anchors suggest show`

Show the why and the diff of a suggestion.

#### Uso

```bash
anchors suggest show <id> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--state` | `pending` | pending\|approved\|rejected |

| **`anchors suggest`** | List, apply and decide the proposed fixes |
